title: Implement typed immutable mathematical IR and verify exact/domain contracts
commitMessage: feat: implement typed immutable mathematical IR core and exact domain guards

contribution.summary: Create the first independent immutable dw.tools.math.ir package after two observed absence REDs. Qualify exact/finite binary64 separation, immutable symbols, scopes, explicit nonzero constraints, one sound real sqrt-square rule, quantity units and ten independently checked contracts plus a locked solution and NuGet package.
contribution.value: Turns the accepted M2 IR architecture into a real provider-free .NET math model that keeps rational precision and symbol-domain restrictions intact instead of silently widening numeric values or applying unsound simplification.
debtChanges: Only M2-W01-C02-T1 is claimed complete. T2 still owns adversarial whole-graph node/depth/matrix limits, binding safety and larger immutable input validation.
The sqrt(square(x)) normalization is one explicitly guarded real-domain rule, not a general CAS, substitution algorithm or equivalence proof.
Canonical JSON, semantic hashes and OpenMath/Content MathML import/export remain M2-W01-C03/future adapter work; no external AURA adoption is claimed.
contribution.nextAction: Run M2-W01-C02-T2 with independent REDs and targeted GREEN for bounded node/depth/matrix and scope safety, then qualify C02 as a complete immutable typed model before starting the canonical JSON codec.

achievements.achievement: Two independent tests fail before implementation, proving the absence of both the dw.tools.math.ir assembly and its exact-scalar/bound-symbol public surface.

Install the first provider-free immutable Math IR package with ExactRational-backed exact scalar, finite binary64 bit-preserving kind, bound/free symbol identities, typed operations and explicit real-domain restrictions.

Ten independent IR tests qualify exact versus approximate numeric identity, nonfinite rejection, signed-zero bits, symbol scopes, sqrt(x²)=abs(x) domain rule, x!=1 exclusions, quantity metadata, collection immutability and invalid-input refusals; locked build, complete quantities/foundation regressions and nupkg contents also pass.

The admitted typed IR functional contract completes with a standalone locked package, independently observed RED/GREEN, guarded one-rule real algebra and durable compilation/package evidence, while T2 adversarial limits remain open.
